Container.Name: no-alias-invoices
Container.Overview:
Local invoice generator with saved recipients, venues and PDF history.
INVOICE EMAIL Set Email provider to microsoft_graph for Outlook.com/Hotmail personal accounts. Set Microsoft client ID to the Application (client) ID from the No Alias Invoices app registration, and Microsoft sender to the Microsoft email account that will send invoices. Leave Microsoft client ID and sender blank in shared/public templates.
After first installing v0.28, open the container Console and run: python /app/connect_microsoft.py
Follow the Microsoft device-login instructions shown. The renewable token cache is stored under /data and therefore persists with Appdata backups and container updates.
For non-Microsoft providers, leave Email provider as smtp and use the existing SMTP settings. TLS is required.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Settings, invoices, Microsoft token cache and optional private template

Config.Name: Business name
Config.Description: Business name shown in the app and on invoices.

Config.Name: Company logo
Config.Description: PNG/JPEG URL or container path, e.g. /data/logo.png.

Config.Name: Email provider
Config.Description: Use smtp for conventional SMTP providers or microsoft_graph for Outlook.com/Hotmail OAuth.

Config.Name: Microsoft client ID
Config.Description: Application (client) ID from the Microsoft app registration. No client secret is used.

Config.Name: Microsoft sender
Config.Description: Microsoft account email address used to send invoices.

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Mail server hostname. Used when Email provider is smtp.

Config.Name: SMTP port
Config.Description: Normally 587 for STARTTLS or 465 for SSL.

Config.Name: SMTP sender
Config.Description: Sender address used when Email provider is smtp.
